verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any web-facing government service, so the axis applies. The only robots probe shows the franchise-tax filing host (icis.corp.delaware.gov/robots.txt) returns HTTP 404, meaning no published crawl policy on the host where the mandatory online filing lives. The main corp.delaware.gov domain was not probed for robots.txt, so there is no evidence of a real robots.txt anywhere, which lowers confidence.
